normalization: Project mode, fixed context archive placeholder; schema structure included. Character counts are not tokens.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read current text from any local file; prefer for known paths. Relative paths resolve from cwd. offset is a 1-based starting line; limit is a line count (default 400), not an ending line.
tools.promptSnippet: read: Read current local text files by path, optionally by line range.

filePath.description: Local file path; relative paths resolve from cwd and absolute paths may point anywhere

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Run commands in cwd; return stdout, stderr and exit_code. Use for tests, git, or rg (current text, regex, exhaustive matches). Prefer read/edit/write for file operations. Check exit_code. If output is truncated, use read or bash to inspect the reported Full output path instead of rerunning the command. Also readable: session context archive at /SESSION_CONTEXT (compacted history + spilled tool outputs).
tools.promptSnippet: bash: Run commands, tests, git, or rg searches of current contents. Prefer read/edit/write for file operations.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Replace exact text in a workspace/global Skill file; prefer over shell patches. Read the relevant content first. oldString must match uniquely unless replaceAll=true; use surrounding text to select one occurrence.
tools.promptSnippet: edit: Make exact, targeted replacements in workspace/global Skill files; use replaceAll for all occurrences. Prefer over shell patches.

filePath.description: File path to edit, relative to cwd or absolute under cwd/global Skill directories

replaceAll.description: Replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully overwrite a workspace/global Skill text file; creates parent directories. Prefer over shell redirection. Use edit for targeted changes.
tools.promptSnippet: write: Create or fully overwrite workspace/global Skill text files; creates parent directories. Prefer over shell redirection.

filePath.description: File path to write, relative to cwd or absolute under cwd/global Skill directories

tools.name: code_search
tools.description: Rank literal keyword matches in an indexed snapshot; return one snippet per file with path and lines. No embedding/semantic matching; translate intent into likely code keywords. Empty results do not prove absence. For current or exhaustive matches use bash with rg; for symbol definitions and calls prefer codegraph.
tools.promptSnippet: code_search: Find ranked keyword matches in an indexed snapshot; returns file paths and snippets, not all matching lines.

path.description: Restrict to files under this relative path

tools.name: codegraph
tools.description: Query indexed symbols: search locates definitions; callers finds direct callers; callees finds direct callees. impact lists affected nodes to depth, including the target and file nodes; it does not label each node's call depth. For exact call layers use callers. status is diagnostic. Use source/text search when graph evidence is insufficient.
tools.promptSnippet: codegraph: Prefer for symbol definitions, callers/callees and change impact. For known symbols, call the matching action directly.

symbol.description: Symbol name (the search result's node.name, NOT its opaque node.id); required for callers, callees, and impact

kind.description: Optional search kind, e.g. function, class, method, interface, component

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a focused task to isolated workers; they do not see this conversation. Include context, constraints and expected output. Use direct tools for simple lookups or quick edits.
tools.promptSnippet: subagent: Delegate focused work to isolated workers; include context. Use direct tools for simple lookups.

message.description: Complete, self-contained instructions for the workers. Include the goal, relevant context, constraints, and expected output; workers do not share this conversation.

mode.description: ask = read-only research; code = isolated coding with diff; parallel = multiple independent attempts (default 3); review = dedicated review pass. Omit to auto-infer.

workflow.description: How workers are scheduled. parallel = all at once (default). sequential = one after another, each sees prior workers' conclusions. pipeline = chained, prior output feeds next (for 调研→实现→审查 flows). Omit to auto-infer.

name.description: Short label for the worker, e.g. '方案 A' / 'Security Review'.

task.description: Self-contained instructions for this worker. Include the goal and any constraints.

dependsOn.description: Names of prior workers this one depends on (pipeline/sequential). Omit to infer sequential order.

workers.description: Custom worker breakdown. Maximum 5 workers. Omit to let the planner auto-build workers from the mode.

summary:
- read: Read current local text files by path, optionally by line range.
- bash: Run commands, tests, git, or rg searches of current contents. Prefer read/edit/write for file operations.
- edit: Make exact, targeted replacements in workspace/global Skill files; use replaceAll for all occurrences. Prefer over shell patches.
- write: Create or fully overwrite workspace/global Skill text files; creates parent directories. Prefer over shell redirection.
- code_search: Find ranked keyword matches in an indexed snapshot; returns file paths and snippets, not all matching lines.
- codegraph: Prefer for symbol definitions, callers/callees and change impact. For known symbols, call the matching action directly.
- subagent: Delegate focused work to isolated workers; include context. Use direct tools for simple lookups.
